unit.finding: In v0.1.12, Matcher::from_system() is a public constructor that calls Builder::from_system(). Builder::from_system() starts from environment-derived proxy settings and, when client-proxy-system is enabled, conditionally invokes mac::with_system on macOS or win::with_system on Windows before build(). Therefore the tagged source exposes a public source-level path that incorporates platform system proxy configuration when the feature and supported target cfg are present.
unit.evidence_scope: Source-level control-flow and public API reachability only. The inspected file proves the public constructor and cfg-gated calls into platform system helpers; it does not prove the contents of those helpers, compilation on a target, runtime discovery success, OS-specific precedence details, network behavior, TLS/routing behavior, package-registry behavior, or another version/project.

conflict_check: No O, downstream, other-worker, legacy, shared-ledger, or other-role semantics were consumed. The unit used only current sanitized controls, own LATEST, and one official tagged public source file.
residual_uncertainty: The exact platform-specific values written by mac::with_system or win::with_system remain unverified.
Build-time target resolution and runtime system proxy discovery remain untested.
End-to-end richer-mode outcome parity remains unverified.
